samples.summary: `sheets export` progress notice is written to stdout, not stderr, contradicting the stream contract this change codifies
samples.evidence: Lines 52-54: `if (!opts.quiet) { console.log(`Exported to ${file}`); }`. The diff's new doc comment in formatter.ts and docs/design/cli.md §9 establish that stdout carries only the result body while progress notices go to stderr (every other notice — output/binary.ts:39, docs/content.ts:142, commands/docs.ts:292/307 — uses stderr). Here a notice lands on stdout, so `wafflebase sheets export doc out.csv > result.json` writes a human notice into the machine-readable stream. Not introduced by this diff (which only changed line 57 in this file), but it is the one remaining place where the invariant the change asserts is violated.

samples.summary: The new 'regression guard for #660' cannot detect the regression it names — it exercises `output()` directly, never a command under `--quiet`
samples.evidence: The comment claims the tests guard against `--quiet` being threaded back into the body/error emitters, but `output({a:1},'json')` and `output([{a:1}],'csv')` call the emitter directly and the emitter no longer has any quiet branch, so those assertions are unconditionally true. The stated acceptance criteria (`wafflebase schema --quiet` prints the same body; a failing command under `--quiet` still prints the envelope on stderr) are untested — a future `if (opts.quiet) return;` added inside any command action (e.g. schema.ts:26, docs.ts:83) would reintroduce the exact bug with a green suite. The 'fails to compile' claim covers only reintroduction via the emitter signature, not via a caller-side early return.
searchedFor: grep 'quiet' across packages/cli (src, test, README, skills)
searched for any CLI command-level/integration test invoking createProgram with --quiet

samples.summary: `outputError` hardcodes exit code 1 while the documented error matrix requires exit 2 for backend/network/system failures
samples.evidence: docs/design/cli.md:951-955 specifies exit 2 for backend 401/403 (UNAUTHORIZED), 5xx/network (SYSTEM), Yorkie attach and font-load failures. Commands funnel all of these through `throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`)` → `outputError(e)` (api-keys.ts:18/21, cells.ts:25/28, docs.ts:103/106, tabs.ts:15/18), and `outputError` unconditionally sets `process.exitCode = 1`, so a caller cannot distinguish a user error from an auth/system failure by exit code. Pre-existing rather than introduced here, but this diff rewrote the function and its contract comment (which now claims the envelope tells the caller 'whether it is retryable') without addressing the exit-code half of that signal.
